question: How many work orders did we open last month?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM work_orders WHERE opened_at >= '2026-05-01' AND opened_at < '2026-06-01'

question: How many technicians are currently active?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM technicians WHERE is_active

question: How many commercial customers do we have?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM customers WHERE segment = 'commercial'

question: What is the total value of overdue invoices?
gold_sql: SELECT sum(amount) FROM invoices WHERE status = 'overdue'

question: List our HVAC parts with their unit prices, most expensive first.
gold_sql: SELECT name, unit_price FROM parts WHERE category = 'hvac' ORDER BY unit_price DESC, id

question: How many work orders are still open, scheduled or in progress?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM work_orders WHERE status IN ('open', 'scheduled', 'in_progress')

question: What's the average hourly rate for our senior technicians?
gold_sql: SELECT avg(hourly_rate) FROM technicians WHERE skill_level = 'senior'

question: How many urgent work orders have come in so far this year?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM work_orders WHERE priority = 'urgent' AND opened_at >= '2026-01-01' AND opened_at < '2026-06-30'

question: Which technicians did we hire in 2025?
gold_sql: SELECT full_name FROM technicians WHERE hired_at >= '2025-01-01' AND hired_at < '2026-01-01'

question: How many invoices have been voided?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM invoices WHERE status = 'void'

question: What is the single most expensive part we sell, and what does it cost?
gold_sql: SELECT name, unit_price FROM parts ORDER BY unit_price DESC, id LIMIT 1

question: How many service sites do we have in Texas?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM sites WHERE state = 'TX'

question: How many labor hours did we bill on work orders completed last quarter?
gold_sql: SELECT sum(labor_hours) FROM work_orders WHERE status = 'completed' AND completed_at >= '2026-01-01' AND completed_at < '2026-04-01'

question: How many customer accounts are marked inactive?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM customers WHERE NOT is_active

question: How many work orders have no technician assigned?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM work_orders WHERE technician_id IS NULL

question: How many back-office users have the admin role?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM users WHERE role = 'admin'

question: How many work orders of each job type did we open last year?
gold_sql: SELECT job_type, count(*) FROM work_orders WHERE opened_at >= '2025-01-01' AND opened_at < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY job_type

question: What was our invoiced amount each month in 2025, excluding voided invoices?
gold_sql: SELECT date_trunc('month', issued_at) AS month, sum(amount) FROM invoices WHERE status <> 'void' AND issued_at >= '2025-01-01' AND issued_at < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

question: Which region has the most customers?
gold_sql: SELECT region, count(*) FROM customers GROUP BY region ORDER BY count(*) DESC, region LIMIT 1

question: What is the average labor time per completed job, by job type?
gold_sql: SELECT job_type, avg(labor_hours) FROM work_orders WHERE status = 'completed' GROUP BY job_type

question: How many work orders has each technician skill level handled in the last 90 days?
gold_sql: SELECT t.skill_level, count(*) FROM work_orders w JOIN technicians t ON t.id = w.technician_id WHERE w.opened_at >= '2026-04-01' AND w.opened_at < '2026-06-30' GROUP BY t.skill_level

question: What are the top 5 parts by quantity used over the last 12 months?
gold_sql: SELECT p.name, sum(wp.quantity) AS qty FROM work_order_parts wp JOIN parts p ON p.id = wp.part_id JOIN work_orders w ON w.id = wp.work_order_id WHERE w.opened_at >= '2025-06-30' AND w.opened_at < '2026-06-30' GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY qty DESC, p.id LIMIT 5

question: Which states have at least 25 of our service sites?
gold_sql: SELECT state, count(*) FROM sites GROUP BY state HAVING count(*) >= 25

question: How many different customers did we do work for last month?
gold_sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT s.customer_id) FROM work_orders w JOIN sites s ON s.id = w.site_id WHERE w.opened_at >= '2026-05-01' AND w.opened_at < '2026-06-01'

question: On average, how many days does it take to complete an urgent work order?
gold_sql: SELECT avg(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (completed_at - opened_at)) / 86400.0) FROM work_orders WHERE priority = 'urgent' AND status = 'completed'

question: List the active technicians based in the west region, alphabetically.
gold_sql: SELECT full_name FROM technicians WHERE is_active AND home_region = 'west' ORDER BY full_name, id

question: How many work orders have we completed this year, broken down by priority?
gold_sql: SELECT priority, count(*) FROM work_orders WHERE status = 'completed' AND completed_at >= '2026-01-01' AND completed_at < '2026-06-30' GROUP BY priority

question: What percentage of the work orders opened last year ended up cancelled?
gold_sql: SELECT 100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'cancelled') / count(*) FROM work_orders WHERE opened_at >= '2025-01-01' AND opened_at < '2026-01-01'

question: How many invoices issued in 2025 were paid after their due date?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM invoices WHERE paid_at > due_at AND issued_at >= '2025-01-01' AND issued_at < '2026-01-01'

question: Which parts category brings in the most parts revenue (quantity times unit price)?
gold_sql: SELECT p.category, sum(wp.quantity * p.unit_price) AS revenue FROM work_order_parts wp JOIN parts p ON p.id = wp.part_id GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY revenue DESC, p.category LIMIT 1

question: How many work orders did each site type generate last quarter?
gold_sql: SELECT s.site_type, count(*) FROM work_orders w JOIN sites s ON s.id = w.site_id WHERE w.opened_at >= '2026-01-01' AND w.opened_at < '2026-04-01' GROUP BY s.site_type

question: Who are our top 3 technicians by total invoiced amount over the last 12 months?
gold_sql: SELECT t.full_name, sum(i.amount) AS invoiced FROM invoices i JOIN work_orders w ON w.id = i.work_order_id JOIN technicians t ON t.id = w.technician_id WHERE i.issued_at >= '2025-06-30' AND i.issued_at < '2026-06-30' GROUP BY t.id, t.full_name ORDER BY invoiced DESC, t.id LIMIT 3

question: Break down 2025 invoiced revenue by customer region and quarter, excluding voided invoices.
gold_sql: SELECT c.region, date_trunc('quarter', i.issued_at) AS quarter, sum(i.amount) FROM invoices i JOIN work_orders w ON w.id = i.work_order_id JOIN sites s ON s.id = w.site_id JOIN customers c ON c.id = s.customer_id WHERE i.status <> 'void' AND i.issued_at >= '2025-01-01' AND i.issued_at < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY c.region, 2

question: Which customers have had more than 15 work orders in the last 12 months?
gold_sql: SELECT c.name, count(*) FROM work_orders w JOIN sites s ON s.id = w.site_id JOIN customers c ON c.id = s.customer_id WHERE w.opened_at >= '2025-06-30' AND w.opened_at < '2026-06-30' GROUP BY c.id, c.name HAVING count(*) > 15

question: For each month of 2026 so far, how many work orders were opened and how many were completed?
gold_sql: SELECT m.month, (SELECT count(*) FROM work_orders w WHERE date_trunc('month', w.opened_at) = m.month) AS opened, (SELECT count(*) FROM work_orders w WHERE w.status = 'completed' AND date_trunc('month', w.completed_at) = m.month) AS completed FROM (SELECT generate_series(timestamp '2026-01-01', timestamp '2026-06-01', interval '1 month') AS month) m ORDER BY m.month

question: What was the average invoice amount per job type for work orders completed last quarter, counting only job types with at least 100 invoices?
gold_sql: SELECT w.job_type, avg(i.amount) FROM invoices i JOIN work_orders w ON w.id = i.work_order_id WHERE w.completed_at >= '2026-01-01' AND w.completed_at < '2026-04-01' GROUP BY w.job_type HAVING count(*) >= 100

question: Which technicians completed at least one work order in every month of last quarter?
gold_sql: SELECT t.full_name FROM work_orders w JOIN technicians t ON t.id = w.technician_id WHERE w.status = 'completed' AND w.completed_at >= '2026-01-01' AND w.completed_at < '2026-04-01' GROUP BY t.id, t.full_name HAVING count(DISTINCT date_trunc('month', w.completed_at)) = 3

question: Which customers paid us more than $20,000 in total on invoices issued in 2025?
gold_sql: SELECT c.name, sum(i.amount) AS paid FROM invoices i JOIN work_orders w ON w.id = i.work_order_id JOIN sites s ON s.id = w.site_id JOIN customers c ON c.id = s.customer_id WHERE i.status = 'paid' AND i.issued_at >= '2025-01-01' AND i.issued_at < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY c.id, c.name HAVING sum(i.amount) > 20000

question: By customer region, what share of urgent work orders were completed within 2 days of being opened?
gold_sql: SELECT c.region, 100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE w.status = 'completed' AND w.completed_at <= w.opened_at + interval '2 days') / count(*) FROM work_orders w JOIN sites s ON s.id = w.site_id JOIN customers c ON c.id = s.customer_id WHERE w.priority = 'urgent' GROUP BY c.region

question: What are the 5 most-used parts on repair jobs for industrial customers over the last 12 months?
gold_sql: SELECT p.name, sum(wp.quantity) AS qty FROM work_order_parts wp JOIN parts p ON p.id = wp.part_id JOIN work_orders w ON w.id = wp.work_order_id JOIN sites s ON s.id = w.site_id JOIN customers c ON c.id = s.customer_id WHERE w.job_type = 'repair' AND c.segment = 'industrial' AND w.opened_at >= '2025-06-30' AND w.opened_at < '2026-06-30' GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY qty DESC, p.id LIMIT 5

question: Which 10 customers owe us the most on unpaid and overdue invoices, among customers with more than one overdue invoice?
gold_sql: SELECT c.name, sum(i.amount) AS owed FROM invoices i JOIN work_orders w ON w.id = i.work_order_id JOIN sites s ON s.id = w.site_id JOIN customers c ON c.id = s.customer_id WHERE i.status IN ('unpaid', 'overdue') GROUP BY c.id, c.name HAVING count(*) FILTER (WHERE i.status = 'overdue') > 1 ORDER BY owed DESC, c.id LIMIT 10

question: Which service sites have had no work orders at all in the last 6 months?
gold_sql: SELECT s.name FROM sites s WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM work_orders w WHERE w.site_id = s.id AND w.opened_at >= '2025-12-30' AND w.opened_at < '2026-06-30')

question: Among technicians with at least 20 completed jobs in 2025, who had the highest average labor hours per job?
gold_sql: SELECT t.full_name, avg(w.labor_hours) AS avg_hours FROM work_orders w JOIN technicians t ON t.id = w.technician_id WHERE w.status = 'completed' AND w.completed_at >= '2025-01-01' AND w.completed_at < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY t.id, t.full_name HAVING count(*) >= 20 ORDER BY avg_hours DESC, t.id LIMIT 1
